_comment: Single source of truth for the public domain. Change 'base' (no trailing slash) and 'cname' (bare domain), then run: python3 build_site.py && git add -A && git commit -m 'domain' && git push.
_verification_comment: Paste only the content= token from Search Console (HTML tag method) and Bing Webmaster Tools; build_directory.py injects the meta tags into index.html. Then submit sitemap.xml and sitemap-news.xml in both. Page-speed step (data-lite.js, lazy bodies, one-at-a-time hero photos) runs in build_directory.py.
tagline: Daily intelligence for city, bush & beach properties across East Africa

newsletter._comment: Buttondown account name. The signup form posts to https://buttondown.com/api/emails/embed-subscribe/<username>. Change 'username' if the account is renamed; build_site.py and the weekly workflow both read it from here.
